description: Search published StatOrigin statistics by indicator, place, industry, or words from the source sentence. Takes one query string (2–120 characters) and returns at most 20 results, each with id, title, and url. The url is the canonical record at https://statorigin.org/stat/{id}. Call fetch with id to read the value, unit, period, region, publisher, and source quote. Read-only: it does not change any record.

query.description: What to search for. A year in the query filters the period.

name: search

id.description: Stable stat_ identifier. Pass it to fetch.

title: Search statistics
